data.title: 奥萝拉 · 遗忘钟楼的凭窗初雪
data.description: 圣域核心废弃钟楼的高窗前。千年前的古旧课桌上落满尘埃。奥萝拉坐在桌沿上，双腿悬空轻轻摇晃，侧首看着窗外落下的第一片白雪，眼眸深处流露出化身为“灾厄魔女”前作为普通人类少女的落寞与叹息。
data.location: decayed antique stone clock tower loft with arched glassless window and dusty wooden school desks
data.action: sitting on the edge of a rustic wooden desk, swinging legs idly while resting chin in palm, gazing out at drifting snowflakes with melancholic softness
data.lighting: subdued twilight blue dusk light entering the window contrasting with pale white snow flakes
data.mood: heartrending ancient nostalgia, fragile lost humanity, poignant quiet beauty
data.promptProse: Aurora in a vintage navy sailor uniform sits on a wooden desk inside an old clock tower, watching falling snow with nostalgic wistful eyes.
data.animaCaption: Aurora in ancient school uniform watching early snow from a forgotten clock tower.
